title: Viewer's theory that the stranger was a kachina spirit guide
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Viewer's theory that the stranger was a kachina spirit guide, about Drumm's first trip to Egypt (year unspecified) at Egypt (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: "That's a cachina that came to make sure you were on the right path."

plain: Geoffrey Drumm is a researcher who says a strange being taught him the true purpose of the pyramids, starting on his first trip to Egypt. On Jesse Michels' podcast he said a viewer named Vince told him the stranger he met was a kachina, a spirit being from Native American Pueblo tradition, sent to make sure he was on the right path. If so, his meeting was a kind of spiritual guidance rather than chance.
